sources.title: Pony type-private fields
sources.version_or_date: Live Pony Classes tutorial; no publication date shown; footer copyright 2025 is not treated as publication evidence.
sources.confirmed: A leading underscore restricts a field to its declaring type; constructors, functions and behaviours instead have package scope.
sources.limits: Underscore-prefixed methods have package/module visibility, so this mechanism alone does not supply class-private helper methods or Swift extension rules. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C29.json.

sources.title: Ada package private declarative region
sources.sections_read: Syntax, Static Semantics paragraphs 6 and 7, and notes on visible/private package parts.
sources.confirmed: The manual specifies an explicit private declaration list whose entities are visible within the package's declarative region, including child units.
sources.limits: Ada grants access within a package and its child units; adapting this to Swift requires defining the class/extension boundary. The community rendering warns that it is unverified. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: post_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C29.json.
